openDecisions: ECE3121 vs ECE3122 (Engineering electromagnetics): course map's stated core unit is ECE3121, but the 2024 Handbook shows ECE3121 was Malaysia-only that year, with Clayton students required to take ECE3122 instead. Using ECE3122 for the Clayton path. Re-check the live Handbook when you're closer to Year 4 in case the split has changed.

ECE4099 (Professional practice) is not in this catalog at all — it was Malaysia-only in 2024 and the course map instructs Clayton students to replace it with a Professional Practice domain unit of their own choice. Add whichever domain unit you pick as a custom unit in the planner.

Science major/elective slots and the Level 4/5 ECE-coded core elective slot are NOT pre-listed here — the planner is where you add your own choices for these (including Commerce units) via 'add custom unit', since they're personal/variable and outside the electrical core dependency chain that's the point of Phase 1.
_meta.placementSource: Official Monash 2025 progression maps, both supplied by Sahel 2026-09-16: E3001 page 6 (Electrical and Computer Systems, single degree) for the defaults, E3005 page 5 for the Commerce double-degree overrides.
_meta.sharedWithMechatronics: ECE2071, ECE2072, ECE2131 and ECE3073 are Part C core units of BOTH Electrical and Robotics & Mechatronics. They carry sharedWith:['mechatronics'] so the catalog filter shows them to a Mechatronics student without duplicating the code into mechatronics.json.
_meta.vintagePolicy: Unit facts here track the CURRENT Handbook, because a unit's requisites are those published for the year you ENROL in that unit. Course STRUCTURE (which units the degree requires) tracks the commencing year instead, because course requirements lock at commencement. Units whose rules changed between the 2025 commencing year and now carry a vintageNote. Re-check with: node scripts/check-vintage-drift.mjs --from 2025 --codes-from <this file>
_meta.courseCodeNote: Sahel is enrolled in E3001 Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) SINGLE degree (4 years, Electrical and Computer Systems) and is applying to transfer to E3005 (Engineering Honours + Commerce, 5 years). Default placements are the official 2025 E3001 map page 6. Units whose slot differs under E3005 carry a "placements" override from the official 2025 E3005 map page 5, which the app uses once the Commerce toggle is on. ENG2005 additionally differs BY SPECIALISATION within E3001 (Y2S1 Electrical, Y2S2 Civil and Mechatronics), hence the "E3001:<spec>" keys.
_meta.electiveStructure: Part C additionally requires ONE unit from Core List A (official map slot: Y4S1) and ONE from Core List A or B (Y4S2). Part E is 36cp / 6 units from the Part E pool — the six 'elective or engineering technical elective' boxes on the map across Y2-Y4. Of the 42 units across those three lists, only 25 have a Clayton offering; the other 17 are Malaysia-only or currently not offered anywhere (ECE4032, ECE4043, ECE4044, ECE4058, ECE4063, ECE4075, ECE4086, ECE4146, ECE4808, ECE4809, ECE4810, ECE4813, ECE5156, ECE5881, MEC5886, MTE3104, TRC2001) and are deliberately omitted. Units already catalogued for Mechatronics carry sharedWith:['electrical'] rather than being duplicated. Each unit's ecseLists field records which lists it belongs to. Source: https://handbook.monash.edu/current/aos/ECSYSENG04
_meta.coreListANote: CONSTRAINT WORTH KNOWING: Core List A is ECE4053, ECE4055, ECE4122 and ECE4886. Only ECE4055 (Power electronic converters) runs Semester 1 at Clayton — the other three are S2-only. Since the official map puts the Core List A slot at Y4S1, that slot is effectively forced to ECE4055 unless you use the Y4S2 slot for List A and take a List B unit in S1 instead.

The current code for Engineering electromagnetics is ECE3121, which is also what the official 2025 E3001 and E3005 progression maps list. Course map names the core unit as ECE3121; 2024 Handbook shows ECE3121 was Malaysia-only that year, with ECE3122 as the required Clayton substitute (mutually prohibiting — you take one or the other).
